# `Q-22-12` — Math Construct Dropped

> A construct with no equivalent in the target's math model was dropped from the output; the rest of the expression is unaffected.

## What this means

Some LaTeX constructs are typesetting instructions rather than mathematics (`\hline` between the rows of an `array`). When the target cannot represent them, quarto-math omits them and reports what was dropped so the omission is not silent.

## Why this happens

Common causes: table rules (`\hline`, `\cline`) inside an `array` environment.

## How to fix it

If the rule matters, consider a table outside the math; otherwise the warning can be ignored.

## Where it is reported

Math diagnostics point into the `.qmd` at the exact characters inside the
`$…$` or `$$…$$` block, including math that spans several lines or sits
inside a block quote or list item. When a `\newcommand` macro is involved,
a problem inside the macro body points at the definition and a problem in
a macro argument points at the use.
